comment: Open-source upstream manifest. Ingest (scripts/ingest.ts) only downloads from these hosts; anything else is refused. No proprietary corpora (RTK, KanjiDamage, Koohii, WaniKani, Kanshudo) appear here or in the pipeline.

sources.role: kanji spine (meanings, readings, grade, strokes, frequency)
sources.attribution: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG), http://www.edrdg.org/kanjidic/

sources.license: EDRDG licence (CC BY-SA family); KRADFILE2 (c) Jim Rose
sentence text CC BY 2.0 FR bulk + CC0 subset (per Tatoeba downloads)

sources.role: radicals, kanji examples, native-speaker audio refs (mnemonics and dictionary numbers excluded)
sources.license: CC-BY 4.0 with exclusions (no mnemonic hints, no Kodansha/Nelson numbers, no textbook groupings)
sources.attribution: kanjialive.com — public credit + link back, changes described

sources.role: per-glyph stroke-order SVGs, fetched on demand and cached
